name: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the organizers' checklist PDF

criteria.text: Operator greets the client and introduces themself by name
Operator clarifies the client's request before answering when it is ambiguous
criteria.na_rule: N/A when the request is already fully clear from the client's message

criteria.text: Information given is correct and complete for the request
The request is resolved or a concrete next step is given
Operator does not leave the client waiting without explanation
criteria.na_rule: N/A when the operator answers every client message promptly

criteria.text: Operator closes the conversation properly (asks if anything else is needed / says goodbye)
criteria.na_rule: N/A when the client left the conversation before the operator could close it

criteria.text: No disclosure of personal data or account details without verification; no rude or misleading statements
